MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 4 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 9
   C. 13
   D. 10

2. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.6
   C. 15.7
   D. 21

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 2/2

4. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 11
   C. 3
   D. 28

5. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 2

6. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 29
   C. 23.7
   D. 23

7. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 19.6

8. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 48
   C. 14
   D. 49

9. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

10. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 32
   C. 4
   D. 12

11. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x + 2

12. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 156

13. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

14. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 49

15. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 18

16. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 42

17. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 8
   C. 49
   D. 24.5

18. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 46
   C. 23
   D. 120

19. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.205
   D. 0.025

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38
   B. 22
   C. 19
   D. 88

21. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 17
   C. 13
   D. 7

22. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 21
   C. 20
   D. 1

23. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 18

24. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 3/4
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/2

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
